profile.headline: Jr Software Engineer
profile.summary: Hello, I am software developer who is looking to gain new skills and make a difference with the code I create. My experience so far has been in web development and creating mixed reality (VR/AR) experiences. I have worked with C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Python, and the Unity game engine.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
I worked as a full stack web developer to improve surgical scheduling software (OpTime).
- Worked on back-end server code (C#), front-end code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, React)
and database queries (SQL) to develop software for healthcare professionals
- Helped manage the development of a new scheduling feature from the initial design to
the release sign-off while incorporating customer feedback throughout the process
- Collaborated with QA to fix bugs and define test cases for new development
- Provided additional support to my team during our transition from using SVN for version
control to using Git for version control
- Performed code reviews for fellow programmers
- Analyzed issues experienced by end users to identify opportunities for enhancements
- Reviewed customer-facing documentation to ensure that it accurately described new
functionality

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Intern @ The Multimodal Interaction Lab
positions.description:
I helped researchers explore new modalities of human computer interaction by developing software to test new input and output devices.
- Developed several virtual and mixed reality projects with Unity and C# that utilized new
technology such as VR headsets and hand trackers
- Created a REST API server with Python and the Flask framework to control IoT devices
from the virtual and physical worlds
- Wrote scripts in Python for parsing Excel files and analyzing data
- Read, summarized, and presented on academic research papers that were used to guide
project development and choose future research directions

company.name: The University of Texas at Dallas

positions.title: QA/QC Intern
positions.description:
I performed various tasks in an office setting to assist the QA/QC department.
- Updated specification sheets for the proper handling of products and material components in policy and procedure management software
- Formatted and edited over 200 documents using the Microsoft Office suite
- Sorted various product samples for faster distribution

projects.title: Chatbot
projects.description: A simple IRC chatbot built on the PircBot Java Framework. The bot responds to commands requesting information about the weather in a specified city or requests for book reviews when given a specific title, author, or ISBN. Information is provided from API calls to Open Weather and the New York Times and parsed with the Gson Java library.

projects.title: BillboARd
projects.description: BillboARd is a mobile app demo for Android that uses augmented reality to make advertisements more interactive with features such as displaying 3D animation models when the phone's camera is pointed at a poster or bringing those posters to life with video overlay. This project was built using Vuforia's image target and database system package for Unity, the Native Gallery Plugin for Unity, as well as with animation completed in Blender.

organizations.name: The Association for Computing Machinery
organizations.description: I was a front-end developer on ACM Project's BillboARd team. We designed an augmented reality mobile app using Unity and Vuforia to make advertisements more interactive.

organizations.name: Wildstang Robotics
organizations.description: Robotics team consisting of members from local high schools that designed robots to compete in tournaments held by VEX and FIRST Robotics
